svg.title: Odyssey, the horse at the tide line
svg.desc: A hand-written timber horse, half sunk beside an olive grassy sandbar. Broken hull panels, iron nails, seaweed and barnacles tell its story. Flat cel colours, editable paths, exact Home bush and bridge-jetty-5 path data, no raster content.

g.title: Low round leafy bush
g.desc: Retains the low broad dome, with small leafy notches added around its edge. No ground shadow. Bottom-centre ground anchor (65, 100). Ducky height 130.
